description: Angular component for configuring a simple card widget in the Thingsboard UI, including form setup, display logic, and configuration handling.

classes.name: SimpleCardBasicConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending BasicWidgetConfigComponent for configuring a simple card widget, managing form state and configuration logic.

methods.name: displayTimewindowConfig
methods.description: Getter that determines if the timewindow configuration should be displayed based on datasources aggregation.

methods.name: onlyHistoryTimewindow
methods.description: Checks if only comparison aggregation is present in datasources, indicating a history timewindow.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group used for widget configuration.

methods.name: defaultDataKeys
methods.description: Provides default data keys, e.g., temperature for the widget.

methods.name: onConfigSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with configuration data when set.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and saves the configuration data from the form into the widget config.

methods.name: getCardButtons
methods.description: Determines which card buttons (e.g., fullscreen) should be enabled based on config.

methods.name: setCardButtons
methods.description: Sets the card button options in the configuration.
